faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1.question: Do you offer vegetarian and vegan options?
faq.q1.answer: Yes, we offer a dedicated selection of flavorful vegetarian and vegan dishes prepared with fresh ingredients. Look for the labels on the menu or ask your server.
faq.q2.question: Can I reserve a table online?
faq.q2.answer: Absolutely. You can reserve a table directly on our website by selecting your preferred date, time, and party size for instant confirmation.
faq.q3.question: Do you offer takeaway and delivery?
faq.q3.answer: Of course. We offer takeaway and delivery through our partners. Choose the order option to get started.
faq.q4.question: Are your ingredients fresh and local?
faq.q4.answer: Yes, we partner with local farms and trusted suppliers to deliver the freshest and highest-quality seasonal ingredients.
faq.q5.question: Do you host private events or celebrations?
faq.q5.answer: Yes, we host private parties, birthdays, corporate dinners, and larger events. Contact our team by phone or email to discuss the details.
